errors.noGamemaster: Beaver's Gamepad: a gamemaster needs to be connected to change the character of a user.

uiConfig.name: User Configuration
uiConfig.hint: Where the players sit around this screen and where their Tiny-User-Interface is shown.
uiConfig.label: Configure users

keyboardGamepad.name: Keyboard gamepad (testing)
keyboardGamepad.hint: Adds a virtual gamepad that is played with the keyboard, to try out the gamepad modules without a gamepad. Arrow keys: left stick pushed all the way (with shift: half way), I J K L: d-pad, Enter: A, Backspace: B. While active these keys do not reach foundry. Assign it to a user in the gamepad configuration like a real gamepad.

gamepadConfig.name: Gamepad Configuration
gamepadConfig.hint: Assign the connected gamepads to users and choose what their sticks and buttons do.
gamepadConfig.label: Configure gamepads

gamepadConfigApp.title: Gamepad Configuration
gamepadConfigApp.info: Press a button on a gamepad to connect it. A row lights up while its button or stick is in use.
gamepadConfigApp.userHint: The user that plays with this gamepad. It moves the token of the character of that user.
gamepadConfigApp.deleteModule: Remove this module from the gamepad
gamepadConfigApp.missingModule: The vtt-module that provides this gamepad module is not active.
gamepadConfigApp.detectAll: Detect all sticks and buttons of this module one after the other
gamepadConfigApp.raw: Browser sees {buttonCount} buttons and {axisCount} axes. Pressed buttons: {pressed}. Moved axes: {moved}.
gamepadConfigApp.rawMissing: The browser does not report this gamepad right now, press one of its buttons.
gamepadConfigApp.rawHint: What the browser receives from this gamepad right now. A stick or button that does not show up here is not sent as gamepad input and can not be used or detected.

detect.button: Press the button on the gamepad that you want to use.
detect.right: Push the stick that you want to use to your right.
detect.down: Pull the stick that you want to use towards you.
detect.any: Move the stick or trigger that you want to use.
detect.timeout: Beaver's Gamepad: nothing detected. The line below the name of the gamepad shows what the browser receives from it.

uiConfigApp.title: User Configuration
uiConfigApp.info: These settings are stored in this browser only: they describe the players sitting around this screen. Every user listed here gets a Tiny-User-Interface on this screen, drag it by its coloured edge.
uiConfigApp.userPositionHint: Where the player sits when the screen lies flat on the table, e.g. top means the player looks at it upside down. Sticks and Tiny-User-Interface are turned accordingly.
uiConfigApp.userPositionPxHint: Coordinates of the Tiny-User-Interface on the screen.
uiConfigApp.userPositionPxCenter: Center the Tiny-User-Interface at the seat of the user.
uiConfigApp.addUserHint: Users that got a gamepad assigned are added automatically.
uiConfigApp.removeUser: Remove the Tiny-User-Interface of this user

TUIGamepadModule.desc: This is a context module. When activated it controls the Tiny-User-Interface

TokenMovement.desc: this module allows to move your token with the stick or the d-pad

snap.label: Gamepad movement: snap to grid
snap.hint: How tokens moved with a gamepad stick or d-pad use the grid. always: the token walks from grid space to grid space. at the end: the token walks freely and moves to the closest free grid space when you let go. never: the token walks freely. A token smaller than a grid space walks on parts of it, e.g. half a grid space for a token of half the width.

speed.label: Speed
speed.hint: Top speed in grid spaces per second, the same on every scene regardless of the size of its grid spaces. Pushing the stick only a little walks slower. Walking freely (snap to grid: at the end or never) the d-pad starts slow and reaches the top speed when held for 2 seconds, grid steps with the d-pad walk with the top speed right away.

TokenRotation.desc: this module allows to control the direction your token is facing

openDoor.desc: this module opens or closes the nearest door in front of your token
